# Example partial inventory excerpt

## Human interaction

171. **Ridicule:** Can challenge arrogance and authority; can also punish difference, vulnerability, and unconventional approaches.

## Information, media, and digital life

576. **Memes:** Compress social meaning, humor, identity, and criticism into easily shared formats; can also become instruments of ridicule and dehumanization.

## Nonverbal communication and unwritten interaction rules

1069. **Conversation framing:** Establishes whether an exchange is understood as joking, debating, negotiating, teaching, or confronting someone.
